The "stack-buffer-overflow READ 2" strongly suggests reading 2 bytes (a UTF-16 char) beyond a stack buffer. The commit `c593863a8 Add cursor bounds check for word boundary assertions` is very interesting because word boundary assertions in regex involve reading characters around a position.

Let me look at the commit `c593863a8` in detail.
